title: Mannar comme interface transdétroit
purpose: Keep the field-derived Mannar example because it makes the fort-network economy tangible without promoting one exhibition panel into an island-wide causal claim.
reason_off_trunk: The pearl, elephant, choya and labour cluster illustrates the north-western interface but is not necessary to the main VOC sovereignty mechanism.
payoff: The reader returns to Jaffna Fort seeing the north-west as a connected economic corridor rather than a Colombo-defined periphery.

placement.section_anchor: ## 1. Jaffna oblige à retourner la carte

content.takeaway: Mannar shows the north-western coast as an Indian Ocean and Palk-Strait interface, not a terminal periphery.
